title: Best Blockchain Developers (2026): Smart Contracts and dApps
description: How to hire a blockchain developer for smart contracts, dApps or integrations: security audits, testing, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Blockchain developers build smart contracts, decentralized applications and integrations with blockchain networks for use cases like digital ownership records, payments, loyalty programs and supply chain tracking. Because deployed contracts are hard to change and can hold real value, security is critical. Projects go wrong when code is not tested or audited, private keys are mishandled, or the project ignores legal rules in its markets. This guide focuses on building responsibly; it is not investment advice.

faq.q: Do I really need a blockchain?
faq.a: Not always. A traditional database is often simpler. A good developer will tell you honestly.

faq.q: What is a smart contract audit?
faq.a: An independent security review of contract code before launch. It reduces risk but cannot remove it.
Your business should control admin keys with secure storage. Never let a developer hold them alone.
